title: How to play
learningObjectives: Move, jump, pick things up and talk to people.
Read the goal, the health bar and the hints.

intro.situation: This is a practice area. Nothing here can hurt you.
intro.goal: Follow the goal at the top of the screen, one step at a time.

questions.speaker: staff
questions.situation: Practice question: what should you do when you hear a typhoon warning?

choices.text: Get ready: prepare a go-bag and listen to advisories.
choices.feedback: Right! In the levels, every choice teaches a safety lesson.

choices.text: Ignore it. It will probably pass.
choices.feedback: Warnings give you time to prepare. In the levels, an unsafe choice costs a little health.

takeaways: The goal is at the top. Hints help if you are stuck.
Wrong choices cost a little health and explain the safe action.
After each level there is a 10-item assessment.
